families.label: Structural solid
families.description: General coarse xrick/RDX solid terrain. Topology determines floor, wall, edge and corner presentation.

families.label: Floor
families.description: Authored floor intent sharing the structural-solid connector/material family.

families.label: Wall
families.description: Authored wall intent sharing the structural-solid connector/material family.

families.label: Ceiling
families.description: Authored ceiling intent sharing the structural-solid connector/material family.

families.label: Solid filler
families.description: Interior/filler terrain with the same coarse solid gameplay semantic.

families.label: One-way platform
families.description: Horizontal one-way construction intent; native xrick remains the resolver.

families.label: Ladder
families.description: Vertical climb-through construction intent on the source 16x16 logic grid.

families.label: Hazard boundary
families.description: Semantic boundary for game-specific hazard ownership; no browser collision solver is implied.

families.label: Transition
families.description: Presentation/structural transition that preserves existing native gameplay meaning unless separately authored.
